## Assignment and root cause

Synchronized clean origin/main at `bad415b673d44fe0732e969c2ae7d9f4ba856ece`.
Consumed H-M0-011 v1 and completed consultation H-M0-010 v3 at that exact SHA,
including review, semantic-v3 probes, all reported results/full errors and validation.

H-M0-011 v2 at `7a7850c6536727c11f582ce77bcf8b01f76e1ab4`, pushed and re-fetched
before implementing. Explicit user reactivation after Skeptic yield supplies writer

Skeptic correctly distinguished independent predecessor validation from cumulative
exposure comparison. Previously a predecessor was checked against its old holdout,
while the current holdout saw only current disclosures. A new version and pin could
therefore discard already known exposure. The caller-only API also omitted standalone
records. The user explicitly expanded the bounded handoff to authoritative local
Research evidence, while retaining Quant's execution/inventory boundary.

## Smallest coherent mechanism

Only production `src/edgelab/research_protocol.py` changes. No new Data identity,
checkpoint machinery, schema version or experiment engine is introduced.

1. Collect custody and exploratory disclosures through **all preregistration
   predecessors**, then all exposure ancestors/previous versions. Compare with the
   current holdout. Existing chronology, exact references, version and cycle checks
   remain. A valid prior pin never makes disclosed outcomes fresh.
2. Require verifier-selected **history_baseline + full history_inventory**, using
   Data verify_history. Missing/mismatched evidence denies. Frozen registration
   bytes must be included in that checkpoint. Proposed first-access bytes must not
   already be accepted history; historical access cannot exempt itself.
3. Enumerate both full typed Research registries in the verifier-selected repository,
   independent of the submitting agent's ancestry and disclosure lists. Inspect all
   Research JSON for misplaced exposure/preregistration records. Include unreferenced
   IDs/versions and current additions, alongside accepted history. Invalid/misplaced/
   untyped/aliased records deny; omissions cannot silently shrink the comparison set.
4. Compare every known EXAMINED population using Data's canonical sample_keys;
   UNKNOWN history denies conservatively, including apparently disjoint UNKNOWNs.
   Exclude only the exact new proposed access itself, retaining its ancestry.
   Recheck record hashes and accepted-history preservation before returning.

Success now says **CONSISTENT_AUTHORITATIVE_RESEARCH_EVIDENCE**, with
history_completeness=VERIFIED_RESEARCH_REGISTRIES_ONLY, checkpoint SHA, checked
Research record hashes, Data membership digest and operational_authorization=false.
There is no legacy success fallback when authoritative history cannot be established.
No auto-acceptance of HEAD or author-provided record list occurs in production.

The universe is `research/exposures/*.json` and `research/preregistrations/*.json`,
including cumulative typed dependencies. Tests/reports are archived examples, not
active records. Misplaced typed Research records elsewhere under research/ fail
closed. Legacy experiments are not interpreted as exposure logs; Quant must supply
typed execution evidence. This is repository Research-evidence closure, not a
complete execution-time trial inventory. Any invalid authoritative record currently
blocks assessment; correcting/quarantining legacy invalid evidence requires reviewed
contracts, not silently omitting it to obtain a positive result.

and explicit verifier checkpoints. No production checkpoint is created or accepted.
Every test starts from a passing checkpoint-backed fresh contract. Fixture writing
utilities are reused without editing any published test or its setup. All **27**
methods pass.

## Boundaries and review requirement

Data's canonical namespace/event/outcome identity is unchanged. Renaming files,
dataset labels or record IDs cannot evade canonical overlap; falsifying the upstream
identity mapping remains outside truthful-input assumptions. Custody/access statements
are not authenticated external truth. Access erased before entering any trusted
checkpoint or never recorded by EdgeLab cannot be reconstructed by local code.

The verifier must select a current complete accepted checkpoint under the existing
external acceptance/predecessor policy. This code verifies the supplied full baseline
and inventory, not the honesty/security of their supplier. A compromised verifier,
forged or deliberately stale accepted baseline, fabricated observations or falsified
canonical IDs are not solved here. Operational trust remains unprovisioned.

Quant retains mandatory experiment integration, complete execution-time inventories,
actual split/input binding, reproduction and confirmatory enforcement. It must ingest
execution exposure evidence and recheck currency/races at execution. Research's
before/after hashes do not claim an atomic filesystem transaction. Risk retains
STOP/authority/lifecycle/capital controls. Existing structural validation of a legacy
experiment is not fresh confirmation or operational permission.

Changed file groups: Research module; appended SPECIFICATIONS v2; one new owner test
file; new Research report/logs/results, claim/completion/review request/audit/inventory.
No Data module, validator, schema, capital, STOP, project-state or published test edits.

Research does not close R01. Completion will request independent Skeptic re-review
with exact landing SHAs and a content-hashed inventory. Director alone coordinates
any subsequent release; Quant remains held.
